On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown

many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

]

# 90° clockwise: for cell (i,j) in output, it comes from (rows-1-j, i) in input
# Or equivalently, output[j][cols-1-i] = input[i][j]
# Which gives: output[j][i] = input[rows-1-j][i]

rows = len(input_grid)
cols = len(input_grid[0])

# Actually the formula for 90° clockwise:
# new_grid[col][rows-1-row] = old_grid[row][col]
# So: new_grid[col][new_row] = old_grid[rows-1-new_row][col]

# This is simpler: read columns from bottom to top to form new rows
rot90 = []
for j in range(cols):
    new_row = [input_grid[rows-1-i][j] for i in range(rows)]
    rot90.append(new_row)

# This creates a 10x13 grid
print(f"90° rotation dimensions: {len(rot90)}x{len(rot90[0]) if rot90 else 0}")
print("First 3 rows:")
for row in rot90[:3]:
    print(row[:13])
